whenToUse: Agent turns: reasoning, tool calls, subagents and the sources behind an answer
Run logs that expand to output, from CI jobs and data builds to webhook deliveries
Checklists of automated checks or setup steps with running, failed and pending states

whenNotToUse.when: One short status line per step with no expanding detail or status color
Dated events or milestones joined by a connecting line
A complete run console with approvals, log views and an outcome report

agentNotes: Status is shown by color and motion only, so every `TraceTitle` must also say in words that a step is running, failed or not started
A `TraceLine` on its own is a plain span; wrap it in a link or a Dialog, Sheet or Popover trigger to make it act
